summary: Keep a deleted watched directory from blocking unrelated file subscriptions and replacement ancestor watches

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: File subscriptions remain host-local and in memory.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or reconciliation policy changes.

compatibility.detail: A retained lease for a missing root no longer aborts acquisition by another subscriber. New acquisitions still require their requested roots to exist, other filesystem errors remain errors, and canonical identity validation and reference-counted release are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary deployment restart.

manual.detail: No directory preservation, configuration change or state repair is required.

recovery.detail: Logical subscriptions remain available for recreation until their owners release them; removed physical coverage still wakes subscribers. No persistent state or rollback format changes.
